text:
maria-g: FYI — Lifeline Hospital (customer) just escalated. Their e-discovery export is failing with a 403 during download. They say exported archive is missing events from Sep–Dec 2024 and they've got an active BAA. Asked for urgent help / legal timeline. :lock: :rotating_light:

csm_lifeline: We surfaced this in the legal team call — they need confirmation of HSM-backed key usage and the audit export contents. They saw a 403 when trying to download: 'Access denied: kms:unauthorized'.

maria-g: Repro steps from support ticket: created export job via Console -> Exports -> New -> date range 2024-09-01..2024-12-31, selected "include audit logs", status shows completed, but download fails with 403. job id: exp_2024_09_12_lh_77

ajay-s: Thanks. Can you paste the exact error payload from the download request? Also which region is the export in?

maria-g: Pasting the error blob from frontend logs (redacted):
```json
{"status":403,"error":"Forbidden","message":"kms:unauthorized for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01"}
```
region: us-west-2.

audit-bot: export_job exp_2024_09_12_lh_77: created by csm_lifeline at 2024-12-15T18:23:10Z -> completed 2024-12-15T18:24:02Z -> archive s3://redwood-exports/lifeline/exp_77.tar.gz (kms_key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01)

ajay-s: Ok — that points to the S3 object encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key. Error suggests the runtime doing the download doesn't have kms:Decrypt on that key or there's a key policy condition blocking it. Two quick asks: 1) can we check KMS key policy that we store for exports? 2) any recent HSM/KMS rotation or cross-account changes for Lifeline?

kevin-t (Eng-Infra): We rolled a rotation job for customer-managed export keys on 2025-01-05 across some tenants, but Lifeline wasn't on the list. I'll check infra logs for any access denials in the kms proxy.

nina-k (Security): If this is HSM-backed (external HSM or custom KMS policy), legal will want attestation that the key is HSM-protected and that the export process used that key. Maria — can you confirm whether Lifeline requested HSM-protected keys in their onboarding? Also need the export manifest (file list) to verify missing events claim. :eyes:

maria-g: CSM says they opted for "managed KMS (HSM)" on signup. Attached in ticket: onboarding flag = managed_hsm:true. Export manifest from the job (sanitized):
```
{
  "job_id":"exp_2024_09_12_lh_77",
  "objects":["audit/2024-09-01.log","audit/2024-10-05.log","audit/2024-11-20.log","audit/2024-12-15.log"]
}
```
Customer claims there should also be audit/2024-09-15.log and audit/2024-10-22.log — they don't appear in archive listing but should be within range.

ajay-s: Two hypotheses: (A) export job filtered events due to retention/rolloff policy (maybe those days were auto-archived earlier), (B) a partial upload failed and S3 object missing some parts. First step: I'll attempt a backend rehydrate of that archive to our staging account (with proper kms access) to validate contents. If we hit kms:unauthorized we can collect kms CloudTrail deny event.

deploy-bot: deploy v4.2.1 to export-service started by ajay-s at 2025-01-12T14:01:05Z

ajay-s: Running repro now — curl of download URL from export-service host (staging) returns: 403 with same kms error. Request id: r-0a1b2c3d. Logged CloudTrail denies for principal arn:aws:sts::REDACTED:assumed-role/export-service-role.

kevin-t (Eng-Infra): Got the CloudTrail snippet:
```text
EventTime: 2025-01-12T14:02:10Z
EventName: Decrypt
ErrorCode: AccessDeniedException
UserIdentity: arn:aws:sts::REDACTED:assumed-role/export-service-role
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01
```
Key policy currently: allows account root and a tight list of principals — doesn't include the export-service-role because for HSM-managed keys we require an STS condition for a specific external-id. Looks like Lifeline's onboarding flow created a key policy with external-id restriction that blocks our cross-account role.

nina-k: That matches. Legal will want to see the exact key policy and the attestation. For the missing events, we need to show chain of custody: when each audit file was written, whether it was retained, and whether it was included in the export job at creation time. Maria — can you pull write timestamps for the missing files from our audit index?

maria-g: Pulling index... got writes: audit/2024-09-15.log written 2024-09-15T23:58:10Z, audit/2024-10-22.log written 2024-10-22T02:12:33Z. They exist in index but don't appear in S3 archive listing.

ajay-s: That indicates the export job likely failed to include those objects during packaging. Two parallel lines: 1) fix kms access so customer can download current archive (short term); 2) schedule a re-run of the export job that will re-package the index and ensure the missing files are included. For (1) we need an approved temporary workaround: either adjust key policy to include export-service-role OR perform a proxy decrypt on behalf of customer if contract allows.

nina-k: We cannot change customer's KMS key policy without explicit authorization. Get written approval from Lifeline and legal sign-off. If they authorize, we can request they add our role to the key policy or provide a grant for decrypt. Alternative: request Lifeline to create a one-time export key and share via secure channel. Legal prefers the grant approach with audit trail.

csm_lifeline: We have a call with Lifeline legal at 16:00 PT. They said they'd be open to creating a KMS grant if it helps immediate access. They'll ask their cloud security team to do that during the call.

maria-g: Action items captured:
- ajay-s: collect CloudTrail deny events and internal request logs (by EOD) [owner].
- kevin-t: prepare exact key policy snippet and explain granting options (by EOD) [owner].
- nina-k: prepare attestation template and legal notes on allowed workarounds (by tomorrow) [owner].
- support/csm: request written customer authorization for policy/grant change during 16:00 PT call.
- ajay-s: schedule a re-run of export job after grant validated and verify contents (post-grant).

ajay-s: Quick notes for repro and future prevention: add validation stage in export worker to confirm decryptable objects for staging role before packaging; if any objects fail Decrypt, mark job as 'partial-failure' and surface missing files to user immediately. I'll open an infra ticket for that.

kevin-t: Filed INFRA-3821: "export worker: prepackage KMS decrypt validation + clearer error" — assigning to export-service.

maria-g: Customer wants ETA. If Lifeline grant happens on call, we can validate download within ~30–45 mins and re-run export within 2 hours. I'll tell them that. :calendar:

csm_lifeline: Sending update now to Lifeline legal.

nina-k: Also request HSM attestation doc upload to the support ticket so legal can close loop.

maria-g: Thanks all. I'll update thread after the 16:00 call. :thumbsup:
